review_notes: Reviewed all 108 lines and inspected the related frame-basis simp lemmas, polynomial tangent definitions, and the downstream geometry use. The one finding is a missing simplification for the successor case; I did not identify competing rules or a rewrite cycle.

findings.excerpt:
fun i => primeNormalProjection Q
    (frameBasis m (polynomialResidueMap Q (X 0)) hy i)
findings.problem: The frame-basis successor rule does not simplify through this wrapper. Thus `primeLogarithmicNormals Q hy i.succ` stays expressed using `frameBasis`, although the frame basis at a successor is exactly the coordinate basis vector. This hides the canonical overlap between the logarithmic and coordinate normal families when users simplify basis conditions or compare these normals.
findings.proposed_change: Add a successor equation lemma with `[simp]`, for example `@[simp] lemma primeLogarithmicNormals_succ ... (i : Fin m) : primeLogarithmicNormals Q hy i.succ = primeCoordinateNormals Q i.succ := by simp [primeLogarithmicNormals, primeCoordinateNormals, primeNormalProjection]`.
findings.benefit: The safe, one-way successor reduction would expose the shared normal and let simplification discharge successor cases in downstream comparisons, without unfolding the definitions globally or changing the zero-index logarithmic case.
